name: Yin
source:
A graduate of the Web assassin school and a classmate of Ding Xiu.
She was a hostess at the Dragon & Phoenix nightclub and had a secret crush on Zhang Lei.
She was under the jurisdiction of Lao Pao, but was put in charge when Chu Yuk-Gong requested a female spider to protect her daughter Sammi and be her companion.
She is a little dismayed at Sammi's upbringing as a sheltered princess, but she also understands that she is at the mercy of her destiny and offers her a helping hand.
She ends up participating in the attack on Lao Pao's fortress manshion.
